# CM Ear Wax Removal

> Mobile ear wax removal (microsuction, ear irrigation and manual removal) delivered to your home across Bentley, Hampshire and the surrounding area. All ages welcome.

CM Ear Wax Removal is a mobile ear care practice run by Cristiana Mamularu, a fully trained, qualified and insured Ear Health Practitioner certified by UK Microsuction. She visits private homes, residential homes and care homes to safely remove ear wax using microsuction, ear irrigation and manual removal — no travel or waiting rooms required. She sees clients of all ages, from children old enough to sit still through to elderly residents in care homes, and brings a video otoscope to every visit, displaying live footage of the ear canal on a small screen throughout.

## Services & Prices

- **Microsuction** — gentle, dry wax removal under magnified vision using a medical-grade suction device. No water involved, suitable even with a perforated eardrum or grommets. Price: please enquire via WhatsApp.
- **Ear Irrigation** — a controlled, pulsed flow of warm water safely flushes softened wax from the ear canal using a modern electronic irrigator. Price: please enquire via WhatsApp.
- **Manual Removal** — hard or oddly-positioned wax cleared by hand, using fine precision instruments under close magnification, for wax that suction or irrigation alone can't shift. Price: please enquire via WhatsApp.

## Who She Works With

- Private clients: one-to-one home visits booked directly, no referral needed.
- GP surgery patients: many GP surgeries no longer offer ear wax removal on the NHS, or have long waits for it. Clients can self-refer and book directly with CM Ear Wax Removal; anything beyond straightforward wax build-up is referred back to the client's GP or an ENT specialist.
- Retirement & care homes: visits arranged directly with the home's manager or with family members, seeing several residents in a single trip.

## Coverage Area

Based in Bentley, Hampshire (GU10), covering a 10+ mile radius including Farnham, Alton, Odiham, Bordon, Haslemere, Liphook, Hindhead, Aldershot and Godalming.

## About

Cristiana Mamularu is an Ear Health Practitioner, fully trained, qualified and insured, and certified by UK Microsuction. She provides gentle, unhurried ear wax removal visits, explaining each step clearly, with a focus on comfort and safety, and brings a video otoscope to every visit so clients can watch their own ear canal on screen throughout.

## Why Ear Health Matters

- Hearing aid users: hearing aid moulds and the natural ageing process both increase wax build-up, a common cause of whistling, feedback and muffled hearing aid performance. Regular checks help keep hearing aids working properly.
- Healthy ageing: hearing loss is recognised as one of the most significant modifiable risk factors for dementia, and research shows treating it can meaningfully reduce that risk — part of why CM Ear Wax Removal visits residential and care homes.
- Tinnitus & dizziness: blocked ears are a common, treatable cause of tinnitus, a feeling of fullness, and dizziness, often resolved simply by removing the wax.
